HP - Within TotalEnergies Company (c.f. section 2.3 of Company Rule CR EP FP 454), a well qualified as HPHT - high pressure and high temperature - is a well with:  1/ An expected wellhead shut-in pressure exceeding 10,000 psi (690 bar) and 2/ a bottom hole temperature (static or dynamic) higher than 150°C (300°F)

HT - Within TotalEnergies Company (c.f. section 2.3 of Company Rule CR EP FP 454), a well qualified as HPHT - high pressure and high temperature - is a well with:  1/ An expected wellhead shut-in pressure exceeding 10,000 psi (690 bar) and 2/ a bottom hole temperature (static or dynamic) higher than 150°C (300°F)

Critical Well - A well qualified as “critical” by meeting any of the below criteria:      1/ Targeting Pre-Salt and/or     2/ Total Vertical Depth Below Mudline greater than 15,000ft and/or     3/ Borehole pressure anticipated at 15,000psi or higher, and/or     4/ Borehole temperature anticipated at 175°C or higher and/or     5/ Water depth greater than 3,0000 meters     6/ Wells drilled using mud weights that are intentionally “balanced” or “under balanced”.
